01

“By the racers, panting”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 100:1).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
By the racers, panting [al-ʿAdiyat: 1], meaning: “the horses, panting.”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا [العاديات: 1] ، يَعْنِي: «الْخَيْلَ تَضْبَحُ»
Edition record 373897 · p. 743Link to report ↗
02

“and the producers of sparks by striking”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 100:2).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding His saying:
and the producers of sparks by striking [al-ʿAdiyat: 2], meaning: “the scheming of men.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَالْمُورِيَاتِ قَدْحًا [العاديات: 2] ، يَعْنِي: «مَكْرَ الرِّجَالِ»
Edition record 373898 · p. 743Link to report ↗
03

“and the raiders at dawn”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Ibn Masʿūd (Q 100:3).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and the raiders at dawn [al-ʿAdiyat: 3], he said: “meaning the horses; he said: and that is in battle.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا [العاديات: 3] قَالَ: " يَعْنِي الْخَيْلَ، قَالَ: وَذَاكَ فِي الْقِتَالِ "
Edition record 373899 · p. 743Link to report ↗
04
Explanation from Ibn Masʿūd 04

Ibn Masʿūd

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, from Ibn Masʿud, regarding His saying:
and the raiders at dawn [al-ʿAdiyat: 3], he said: “meaning the horses; he said: and that is in the Hajj.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا [العاديات: 3] قَالَ: " يَعْنِي الْخَيْلَ، قَالَ: وَذَاكَ فِي الْحَجِّ "
Edition record 373900 · p. 743Link to report ↗
04

“and raise thereby [a trail of] dust”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 100:4).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and raise thereby [a trail of] dust [al-ʿAdiyat: 4], he said: “he means by it the horses.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ
فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا [العاديات: 4] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي بِهِ الْخَيْلَ»
Edition record 373901 · p. 743Link to report ↗
05

“and penetrate thereby into the midst of a host”

Four explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 100:5).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and penetrate thereby into the midst of a host [al-ʿAdiyat: 5], he said: “these and those.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا [العاديات: 5] قَالَ: «هَؤُلَاءِ وَهَؤُلَاءِ»
Edition record 373902 · p. 743Link to report ↗
07
Report from Ibn ʿAbbās 07

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Malik al-Nukri, from Abu al-Jawza’, from Ibn ʿAbbas, who said:
“The kanud is the ungrateful.”
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَالِكٍ الْنُكْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْجَوْزَاءِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
" الْكَنُودُ: الْكَفُورُ "
Edition record 373903 · p. 743Link to report ↗
08
Report from Mujāhid 08

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Shayban narrated to us, from Mansur, from Mujahid, who said:
“The kanud is the ungrateful.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" الْكَنُودُ: الْكَفُورُ "
Edition record 373904 · p. 744Link to report ↗
